items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: So Walter Page, he was leading the band...

ctx.x: We went down there the first time, and we played out on kind of like a lawn(?)... A great big band(?), and they had a big lawn, a big (?) spread out there, and people was dancin' on it. The sheriff comes down with two big pistols on, and he wouldn't let nobody dance but himself! In other words, he didn't want nothing but "Turkey In The Straw" all the time. And we had to play "Turkey In The Straw." So Walter Page, he was leading the band... I told Walter, "There's a man who says he don't want us to play nothin'…
How long did that go on for?
